summary: Puter is a self-hostable 'cloud OS' — a browser desktop/PaaS with a Node.js backend API covering auth/sessions, a filesystem (fsentries), apps, WebDAV, shares, notifications, groups, permissions/metadata metering (DynamoDB KV counters), and subdomain hosting, persisted in MySQL/SQLite/Postgres plus Redis and DynamoDB.
